title: The River of Life, Jesus Is Coming

questions.question: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of ____, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:1 (ESV): "Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb"

questions.question: through the middle of the street of the city; also, on either side of the river, the tree of ____ with its twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit each month.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:2 (ESV): "through the middle of the street of the city; also, on either side of the river, the tree of life with its twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit each month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations."

questions.question: The leaves of the tree were for the ____ of the nations.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:2 (ESV): "...The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations."

questions.question: No longer will there be anything ____, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:3 (ESV): "No longer will there be anything accursed, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him."

questions.question: They will see his ____, and his name will be on their foreheads.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:4 (ESV): "They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads."

questions.question: And night will be no more. They will need no light of ____ or ____, for the Lord God will be their light, and they will reign forever and ever.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 (ESV): "And night will be no more. They will need no light of lamp or sun, for the Lord God will be their light, and they will reign forever and ever."

questions.question: "And behold, I am coming ____. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:7 (ESV): "'And behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.'"

questions.question: Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do ____, and the holy still be holy.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:11 (ESV): "Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still be holy."

questions.question: "Behold, I am coming soon, bringing my ____ with me, to repay each one for what he has done."
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:12 (ESV): "'Behold, I am coming soon, bringing my recompense with me, to repay each one for what he has done.'"

questions.question: "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the ____ and the ____, the beginning and the end."
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:13 (ESV): "'I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.'"

questions.question: "I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of ____, the bright morning ____."
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:16 (ESV): "'I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star.'"

questions.question: The Spirit and the Bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is ____ come; let the one who desires take the water of life without price.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:17 (ESV): "The Spirit and the Bride say, 'Come.' And let the one who hears say, 'Come.' And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires take the water of life without price."

questions.question: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone ____ to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book,
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:18 (ESV): "I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book,"

questions.question: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of ____ and in the holy city, which are described in this book.
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:19 (ESV): "and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book."

questions.question: He who testifies to these things says, "Surely I am coming soon." Amen. ____, Lord Jesus!
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:20 (ESV): "He who testifies to these things says, 'Surely I am coming soon.' Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!"

key_verse_text: He who testifies to these things says, "Surely I am coming soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
